name: 610 Console
description: LUNA as Bill Putnam Sr.'s 1960 United Recording console: eight channels of 610 modules with only the controls a 610 had
(mic/line, gain, L.F. and H.F. shelves, the big level knob, an echo send), doorknob attenuators, a VU meter bridge,
and an 8-track tape machine for tracking.
